scores.notes: Jesus stands at the raised end of the boat with right arm extended over calm water; disciples cling to the mast and gunwales, torn sail and a lit lantern on the deck, villages on the rocky shore. No lettering, frame or anatomy faults seen; full-bleed painting.

Samuel in undyed tunic and blue cloak pours the horn over kneeling David with a faint golden glow, Jesse with staff at left and three brothers at right (one armed, one holding a sling) in a stone courtyard. Hands and edges clean; no lettering.

Jesus calls with raised arm at the cave mouth beside the rolled stone, Martha kneels with clasped hands, mourners behind, Lazarus in linen sits by a lit lamp at the inner tomb niche (left). White deckled paper shows along the left, right and bottom edges (accepted).

Moses sits on a stone with arms held up by a plain-robed man and a priestly-garbed man over a battle plain, but in the middle distance just left of the right supporter's robe (about x810-860, y400-425) uncoloured ink squiggles read as cursive script ('& Abbyd'-like). White paper vignettes at the corners (accepted).

Alice introduces the floating grinning Cat's head while the King peers from behind her, Queen in the distance and card soldiers and a hedgehog present, but the large card the King holds shows an 'A' index in its top-left corner. White paper shows at the top and side edges (accepted).

Samuel in blue cloak pours oil from a horn over kneeling David, who has a faint radiant glow, with Jesse and brothers (one in armour) standing around in a stone courtyard of Bethlehem. Hands, edges and surfaces clean; no lettering.

Pillar of cloud rises from the tabernacle in its white-curtained court at the centre of a wide tent camp while families look up, coil ropes and load donkeys. A tiny striped tablet held by a man at lower left shows no discernible glyphs; no other faults seen.

Father embraces the barefoot son in torn clothes at a stone farm road while two servants enter from the left, one holding sandals and a ring, the other a folded robe; olive trees and warm late light. Embrace hands resolve correctly; no lettering.

Paul sits on a bench gazing upward among seated and standing believers in a stone room, a blank scroll and pen case beside him, doorway view of Corinth at right. The shelf lamp is lit rather than unlit, a minor detail; no faults seen.

Chariots surge between walls of water with Moses at right, but the pillar of fire at top centre forms a human-like figure with a head and outstretched arms over a robed column of flame, a figure for God who must never be drawn. Two kilted men at right walk toward the oncoming chariots, which reads oddly; white paper at the side edges (accepted).

David's throwing hand is empty while the whole sling, stone still in its pouch, flies through the air at top centre; Goliath is already toppling backward before any stone has struck him (not forward on his face), so the moment is contradictory.

Holmes, seated by the window at left, has the recognisable face and curly hair of Benedict Cumberbatch's screen Sherlock, breaking the no-screen-likeness rule. The masked visitor in a fur coat with a glowing brooch, hat and an extra bag stands at the door; Watson sits in a bowler. No legible lettering (clock dials show only tick marks).

Father embraces the barefoot returning son, hand on his head, while two servants approach from the left with a bordered blue robe, sandals and a small ring in an open palm; village road with olive terraces. Robe border is geometric pattern, not glyphs; no faults seen.

Two figures stand either side of a stone bench in a courtyard with jars and distant boats, but the scroll on the bench lies open between two rollers with rows of script-like marks visible on the parchment (centre). White unpainted sky and corners at top (accepted).

Viewed from inside the cave, Jesus calls with raised arm framed by the bright entrance, Lazarus in burial linen sits by a lit lamp in the dark recess at right, Martha kneels with clasped hands and the crowd fills the foreground. No faults seen.

Holmes at the window holding the blue gem has Benedict Cumberbatch's screen face and Watson in the armchair resembles Martin Freeman, breaking the screen-likeness rule; loose papers on the desk beside the open strongbox carry lines of script-like writing.

Golden rays descend from the upper frame through a city gate onto open storehouses glowing with jars and chests, townspeople walking through; Wisdom appears only as light, with no figure in the rays. No lettering or edge faults.

Fiery streaks fall from a smoky sky onto walled burning cities in a valley with glowing bitumen pits, and a herder in the foreground shields his face. Painted to the edges; no figure in the sky, no lettering.

Holmes flinging a ball of papers toward the rack has Benedict Cumberbatch's screen face and Watson resembles Martin Freeman; the newspapers on the seat and floor (lower left and right) show masthead lettering and printed columns. White paper at the left and right edges (accepted).

Moses stands foreground-centre pointing with staff in hand before families with bundles, children, sheep and donkeys, a cloud capping Horeb behind; tents scattered on the plain. Hands and faces resolve; no lettering.

David crouches at the brook picking a stone with sling in hand and stones in his bag, Goliath approaching up the valley, but besides the crook he holds a second straight staff appears from behind his elbow and stands on the ground at left, a duplicated prop. White paper sky and edges (accepted).

Holmes kneeling with lens and lantern in a brick cellar has Benedict Cumberbatch's screen face and hair, breaking the screen-likeness rule; Merryweather sits sulking on a crate with his stick among foil-banded boxes. No lettering seen.

God is drawn as a white-bearded old man seated on the throne at top centre, which neverDrawn and the depiction rule forbid. The four eyed, winged creatures and John on the glassy sea are present, though the man-faced creature has an out-of-style photographic face.

Jesus sleeps peacefully on a cushion at the stern while the storm rages, but no disciple grips or wakes him: the two shouting disciples at centre clutch each other, and the others bail or haul ropes. The asked action of rousing Jesus is not shown.
